text:
maria: Quick follow-up re: yesterday's vendor outage. Cloud provider rate-limit on model-registry writes + auth retries cascaded and caused degraded inference for ~37m. Need owners/timelines for postmortem actions. I sketched a short plan below — please confirm or propose changes.

devin: I can take short-term fallback mirror + circuit breaker. Will spin up mirror and add a 429 circuit-breaker by EOD Mon. ETA: 2026-03-30. :thumbsup:

sanjay: I'll own multi-region push path and SLA conversation with the provider. Target 2026-04-12. Need procurement + legal support. @elaine can you connect?

elaine: Yep, looping in legal/procurement now. Sending vendor escalation thread today. Also will add KVI (key vendor indicators) to our vendor dashboard.

taylor: I'll add alerting: anomaly detector on model-registry write latency + auth retry surge. Will create evals to catch regressions. Target 2026-03-27. Dropping a runbook snippet in case ops want a quick patch.

ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled: mirror-init-job -> sandbox. status: pending. See runbook snippet below.

maria: paste runbook? short snippet ok.

devin: ```
# mirror bootstrap (k8s job)
kubectl apply -f registry-mirror-job.yaml
# circuit breaker config
config:
  model_registry:
    circuit_breaker:
      max_429s: 5
      cooldown: 60s
```

sanjay: Two quick follow-ups: (1) Do we have a fallback auth provider plan? (2) Can we backfill request traces for the 03/18-03/19 window to validate surge correlation?

ryan: I'll take fallback auth provider plan. Can we validate OAuth token caching and TTL before rollout? ETA 2026-04-02.

taylor: I can backfill traces — instrumented exporter has retention but needs a focused run for that window. ETA for backfill job: 2026-03-26. Will post run id when started.

elaine: Procurement blocker: needs a justified SOW change for extra regions. I'll get estimates and a proposal by 2026-03-29.

maria: Owners consolidated:
- Short-term mirror + breaker: devin (due 2026-03-30)
- Alerts + backfills: taylor (alerts due 2026-03-27, traces 2026-03-26)
- Multi-region + SLA: sanjay (due 2026-04-12)
- Fallback auth: ryan (due 2026-04-02)
- Vendor contract change: elaine (due 2026-03-29)
Please add any missing tasks. We'll review in tomorrow's 10:30 incident retro.

devin: Added task in the postmortem doc and created Jira INF-4821. :eyes: 

taylor: Posted tracing run job id: trace-run-20260326-7. Will update the postmortem once complete.

ryan: Will prototype auth cache and share test plan by 2026-03-28.

maria: Thanks — @channel please react with :white_check_mark: if you agree OR list objections. We'll close follow-ups once all owners mark done in the postmortem doc.
